subject: Budget range validation - Novapay
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Budget range validation - Novapay

Alex - great to speak this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so we have alignment before I share formal pricing and contracts.

Key notes from today:
- Use case: customer support assistant + agent assist (summarization + few-shot generation).
- Expected usage profile: pilot = 20-30M tokens/month (first 2-3 months), scale = 120-150M tokens/month (6-12 months).
- Quality/latency requirement: low-latency 8-20ms per token for production; pilot can run on standard model variants.

Questions we flagged:
1) Target $/1M tokens you expect for pilot vs. scale (helps pick model/quantization).
2) Procurement thresholds/PO path (who at Novapay owns vendor onboarding and what monthly amounts trigger formal procurement/legal review).

Initial action items from Redwood:
- I attached a pricing model (Redwood_Pricing_Model_v2.xlsx) with three spend bands and unit economics by model. Link: https://redwood.app/shared/drive/novapay-pricing
- I'll draft an MSA and send for signature once we confirm bands (MSA_Draft_Novapay.pdf attached).

Next steps for you:
- Confirm procurement contact and threshold (PO amount that triggers review).
- Confirm whether pilot volume (20-30M/mo) looks right and whether you want a conservative or aggressive price target.

If it helps, I can propose a specific $/1M token target ranges in a follow-up - want to make sure we align on procurement constraints first.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novapay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Novapay

Thanks, Dylan - good call. A couple quick clarifications.

On Nov 22, 2026, Dylan Brooks wrote:
> Alex - great to speak this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so we have alignment before I share formal pricing and contracts.

- Pilot: yes, 20-30M tokens/month sounds right for the first 2 months.
- Scale: once live across two product lines, we expect 120-150M tokens/month within 6-9 months.

Finance/procurement notes:
- Procurement: our vendor onboarding typically kicks in for >$50k/month; legal review is required for commitments >$100k/month.
- Budget: for procurement planning, leadership is targeting a blended $/1M tokens of approximately $800-1,200 for the first year - lower if we commit to reserved capacity.

Can you provide: 1) a target $/1M tokens you would propose for pilot vs. scale, and 2) an estimate of monthly spend bands so I can build this into our deck? Also please include any minimum commit sizes that would move us to a reserved/dedicated offering.

Thanks - Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of AI Product | Novapay
alex.johnson@novapay.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Novapay

Alex - thanks for the quick clarity on procurement. Based on your volumes and target blended $/1M guidance, below are three practical spend bands we typically use for sizing and procurement conversations. I've included our suggested target $/1M tokens per band plus estimated monthly spend.

Assumptions: prices below are model-variant averaged and assume standard quantization; actuals vary by exact model selection (we can map to specific curated models once you confirm quality/latency preference).

1) Pilot band (20-30M tokens/mo)
- Suggested target: $1,200 per 1M tokens (pilot pricing - includes onboarding credits and 10-15% introductory discount options)
- Monthly spend: 20M => $24,000; 30M => $36,000

2) Growth band (50-80M tokens/mo)
- Suggested target: $900 per 1M tokens (volume discount applied)
- Monthly spend: 50M => $45,000; 80M => $72,000

3) Scale band (120-150M tokens/mo)
- Suggested target: $700 per 1M tokens (reserved capacity pricing or committed discounts)
- Monthly spend: 120M => $84,000; 150M => $105,000

Procurement & contract guidance (based on similar enterprise deals):
- Procurement review: typically triggered at ~$50k/month.
- Legal review & SSO/SCIF requirements: contracts >$100k/month generally require extended legal/infosec review.
- Dedicated/Reserved capacity: often structured as a monthly commit (e.g., $150k-250k/mo) with better unit economics; minimums depend on GPU profile and SLA.

Recommended next steps:
- If Novapay is comfortable with the pilot band target ($1,200/1M), we can prepare a 3-month pilot offer with up to 15% introductory discount for months 1-3 and a clear upgrade path to reserved pricing at scale.
- Please share the procurement contact email so I can send the MSA + standard SOW and the vendor onboarding packet.

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Model_v2.xlsx (attached) - I also uploaded the draft MSA here: https://redwood.app/shared/drive/novapay-pricing and started a DocuSign envelope for the MSA (https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/abcdef123456).

LMK the procurement contact and whether you want me to propose a PO-friendly payment schedule (monthly vs. quarterly) for budgeting.

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-22T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Budget range validation - Novapay

Looping in Rishi from finance to confirm internal approval bands. Per our playbook:
- We can offer up to 15% pilot discount for the first 3 months (aligns with Dylan's suggestion).
- Procurement review threshold: $50k/month - procurement packet required.
- CRO/Revenue approval for non-standard commits required at $150k+/month.

Rishi - can you confirm whether we can accommodate a $1,200/1M pilot target for a 3-month trial and what SLAs would be reasonable to include in the SOW?

Marissa
From: Dana Lee <dana.lee@novapay.com>

Dylan / Alex - procurement here. Confirming our onboarding thresholds: vendor review required at $50k/month, standard PO path is fine for pilots under $100k/month. For anything >$100k/month we need legal review and a completed vendor security questionnaire.

- Please send an itemized pricing matrix we can attach to the PO (line items by model variant and the $/1M token rates).
- Can we set up a 30-min procurement + finance sync next Wed (Nov 25) to confirm payment terms?
